title: Riddle of the Sphinx
statement: An interactive, adversarial riddle hides three nonnegative integers, the leg counts of three mythical creatures. The program asks exactly five questions; each supplies three coefficients between 0 and 10 and receives the claimed total legs of that many creatures. At most one of the five answers may be an outright lie, and which one is unknown. Afterwards the program must print the three exact counts.
